status: proposed geometry for review; not a mesh or validated replica
source: Kimes, Moore and Maslar (2012), DOI 10.1063/1.4742991, Section II and Figures 1-4
coordinates: Right-handed Cartesian system. z=0 at cone top; z increases upwards; main flow is toward negative z. x=y=0 on chamber axis.

junction.provenance: paper estimates 1 mm junction gap; modelled as straight bore

body.provenance: 419 mm reported body length, 102 mm bore; position derived using estimated junction gap

inlets.provenance: approximately 4.8 mm ID on 32 mm pitch circle reported; angular origin chosen; 10 mm tube length assumed

wafer.provenance: 50 mm wafer reported; support-top elevation inferred from diagnostic centre; flush, zero-thickness wafer boundary assumed

support_sections.name: wafer boat envelope
support_sections.provenance: 66 mm diameter and 29 mm boat height reported; flat cylinder replaces recessed underside

support_sections.name: upper housing envelope
support_sections.provenance: 66 mm diameter and 19 mm housing height reported; stacking directly under boat is assumed; mounting cone overlap omitted

support_sections.name: smooth bellows envelope
support_sections.provenance: 76 mm bellows diameter reported; smooth cylinder and 100 mm axial span assumed

support_sections.name: lower stem envelope
support_sections.provenance: 34 mm adapter outer diameter and 224 mm tube length reported; placement to bottom plane assumed; flanges omitted

outlets.provenance: 16 mm nominal exhaust ID reported; exact circular diameter representation, centres, orientation and 10 mm extensions assumed

measurement.provenance: proposed sampling disc 2 mm above wafer; not a solid or boundary
